title: Revival to Resilence V2: Recipes of firm longevity post a successful turnaround
affiliations: Indian Institute of Management Indore, Indian Institute of Management (IIM), Indore - Strategic Management Area, Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology (MANIT) and Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology (MANIT)

detail.title: Revival to Resilence V2: Recipes of firm longevity post a successful turnaround
detail.abstract:
This study revisits Prof. Pradip Khandwalla’s seminal work i.e., Turnaround Excellence (2001). Herein, he examined 120 global corporate turnaround cases of 1980s/90s. We contribute by extending his analysis by tracking revived firms, 25–30 years after a successful turnaround.

Using a longitudinal, data-driven approach, the research shifts focus from short-term recovery to exploration of long-term outcomes, examining how initial turnaround success translates into organizational longevity. Building a strategic perspective!

The central theme is to understand whether the nature of revival efforts merely stabilize firms temporarily or help build enduring capabilities that support survival, resilience, and sustained performance over multiple decades.

AI.tldr: 本研究重新审视Pradip Khandwalla教授关于企业转型的经典研究，通过追踪成功转型企业25-30年后的长期表现，探讨短期复苏如何转化为组织长期生存能力。
AI.research_question: 企业转型努力仅仅是暂时稳定企业，还是能够建立支持数十年生存、韧性和持续绩效的持久能力？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注企业短期转型成功，缺乏对转型后长期效果的追踪分析。本研究旨在填补这一空白，探讨转型是否真正建立企业长期生存能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业转型理论、组织韧性理论、战略管理理论、动态能力理论
AI.method: 纵向数据驱动方法，追踪120个全球企业转型案例中成功转型的企业25-30年后的表现
AI.findings: （基于摘要推断）研究可能发现：成功的转型不仅带来短期复苏，还能建立支持企业长期生存的组织能力和韧性
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展企业转型理论的时间维度，将短期复苏与长期组织能力建设联系起来，丰富组织韧性和动态能力理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者提供转型战略的长期视角，帮助识别真正建立持久能力的转型措施，而非仅追求短期稳定

title: Bulgaria in The Mirror of Russian Disinformation: Strategic Analysis of The Uniform Model and Its National Adaptations
affiliations: European Institute for Strategy and Security and European Institute for Strategy and Security

detail.title: Bulgaria in The Mirror of Russian Disinformation: Strategic Analysis of The Uniform Model and Its National Adaptations
detail.abstract: This strategic analysis examines the structured, pattern-based nature of Russian disinformation in Bulgaria, presenting it not as a series of isolated incidents, but as a highly coordinated “single pattern” adapted to the Bulgarian national context. Using a comparative framework supported by evidence, the analysis examines narrative patterns in Poland, the Baltic States, and Georgia to identify how historical traumas and identity threats are being weaponized. The analysis reveals that the information environment in Bulgaria is saturated with the “Firehose of Falsehood” and “4D” (Dismiss, Distort, Distract, Dismay) model, which exploits systemic vulnerabilities such as low media literacy and polarized historical memory. The analysis is based on precise case comparisons that prove that Bulgarian narratives are localized versions of the “hostile Brussels” and “identity threat” templates successfully tested in Georgia. Furthermore, the analysis links the use of symbolic victims to tactics employed in the Baltic states to provoke moral outrage and undermine Euro-Atlantic solidarity. It concludes by arguing that disinformation poses a national security threat comparable to conventional warfare, and argues for a shift from reactive fact-checking to building long-term cognitive resilience and institutionalized psychological defenses.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析俄罗斯在保加利亚的虚假信息模式，揭示其并非孤立事件，而是针对保加利亚国情的高度协调"单一模式"，利用历史创伤和身份威胁，构成与传统战争相当的国家安全威胁。
AI.research_question: 俄罗斯在保加利亚的虚假信息如何形成结构化、模式化的协调系统？这些模式如何利用保加利亚的历史创伤和身份威胁？
AI.motivation: 虚假信息在保加利亚信息环境中泛滥，采用"虚假信息水炮"和"4D"模型，利用媒体素养低和历史记忆极化等系统性漏洞，构成国家安全威胁。
AI.theoretical_framework: "虚假信息水炮"模型、"4D"模型（否认、扭曲、分散、沮丧）、历史创伤武器化、身份威胁理论、认知战理论。
AI.method: 比较分析框架，通过波兰、波罗的海国家和格鲁吉亚的叙事模式比较，识别历史创伤和身份威胁的武器化方式；基于证据的精确案例比较。
AI.findings: 保加利亚叙事是"敌对的布鲁塞尔"和"身份威胁"模板的本地化版本；使用象征性受害者策略（类似波罗的海国家）激发道德愤怒；虚假信息构成与传统战争相当的国家安全威胁。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出虚假信息作为"单一模式"的系统性分析框架；将历史创伤和身份威胁武器化理论应用于保加利亚情境；扩展认知战理论在国家安全领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议从被动的事实核查转向建立长期认知韧性和制度化心理防御；为政策制定者提供应对虚假信息威胁的具体策略；增强媒体素养和机构应对能力。

title: Uncovering Stock Risk Linkages via Mixed Membership Co-jump Networks
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST), Dept of ISOM and Dept of Finance, Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Information Systems, Business Statistics and Operations Management, Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Information Systems, Business Statistics and Operations Management,  and Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Information Systems, Business Statistics and Operations Management

detail.title: Uncovering Stock Risk Linkages via Mixed Membership Co-jump Networks

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We are grateful to comments from participants at the Conference on Market Microstructure, Quantitative Trading, High Frequency, and Large Data, Chicago, the lst HKUST IAS-SBM Joint Workshop on Financial Econometrics in the Big Data Era, and the 17th Annual Society for Financial Econometrics (SoFiE 2025) Conference. We also thank Zhuoxi Li and Ruizhao Huang for their help and discussions.
declarations.funderStatement: Research partially supported by RGC grants SRFS 2324-6H02 and GRF 16304521.

detail.abstract: Traditional hard clustering methods fail to capture the complex, overlapping risk linkages present in modern markets. While recent work (Ding et al., 2024) identifies broad block structures in stock co-jumps, we demonstrate that this framework can be significantly enhanced by incorporating mixed membership. Specifically, we propose a Degree Corrected Mixed Membership network model with Dependent Multivariate Poisson edges (DCMM-DMP) that allows stocks to belong to multiple latent risk communities simultaneously and a corresponding estimation algorithm (Mixed-SCORE-DMP). We prove that our estimator is asymptotically consistent. Empirically, we show that: (1) the mixed membership framework reveals a more informative and granular risk structure than rigid classifications; (2) peer groups defined by our model generate momentum strategies that significantly outperform benchmarks such as selfmomentum, or momentum based on GICS or analyst coverage; and (3) a "purity" measure derived from our model predicts stock volatility and Sharpe ratios, offering a new dimension for risk profiling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的混合成员网络模型DCMM-DMP，用于分析股票市场的风险社区结构，相比传统硬聚类方法能更好地捕捉重叠风险联系，并在实证中显示出优越的性能。
AI.research_question: 如何更好地捕捉股票市场中复杂的重叠风险联系？混合成员网络模型能否比传统硬聚类方法更有效地识别风险社区结构并产生更好的投资策略？
AI.motivation: 传统硬聚类方法无法捕捉现代市场中复杂的重叠风险联系，而现有研究虽然识别了股票共跳的块结构，但仍有改进空间。需要更灵活的框架来反映股票同时属于多个风险社区的实际情况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于网络科学和统计建模，提出度校正混合成员网络模型（DCMM-DMP），结合依赖多元泊松边，允许股票同时属于多个潜在风险社区。
AI.method: 提出Mixed-SCORE-DMP估计算法，证明估计量的渐近一致性。实证分析包括：比较混合成员框架与刚性分类的信息量；基于模型定义的同行群体构建动量策略；从模型推导"纯度"指标预测股票波动率和夏普比率。
AI.findings: 1)混合成员框架比刚性分类揭示更丰富和细粒度的风险结构；2)基于模型定义的同行群体产生的动量策略显著优于自动量、基于GICS或分析师覆盖的动量基准；3)模型衍生的"纯度"指标能预测股票波动率和夏普比率，为风险分析提供新维度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出DCMM-DMP理论框架和Mixed-SCORE-DMP估计算法，证明估计量的渐近一致性，为分析重叠风险社区提供了新的统计建模方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供更有效的风险分析工具，基于混合成员风险社区构建的动量策略能产生超额收益，"纯度"指标可作为新的风险分析维度，帮助投资组合管理和风险控制。

title: When More is Better (or not): Cybersecurity Investment, Financial Risk, and Board Experience Heterogeneity
affiliations: Auburn University, Auburn University - Harbert College of Business, University of New Mexico - Robert O. Anderson Schools of Management and Pennsylvania State University - Smeal College of Business

detail.title: When More is Better (or not): Cybersecurity Investment, Financial Risk, and Board Experience Heterogeneity
detail.abstract: As cybersecurity threats intensify in the digital age, firm financial risk continues to rise despite considerable surges in cybersecurity investments, raising doubts about the effectiveness of such spending. Integrating signaling theory with the concept of homophily, we examine how cybersecurity investments relate to firm risk through the lens of corporate governance. Using panel data from 1,071 firms between 2011 and 2020 (7,892 firm-year observations), we uncover an inverted U-shaped relationship: initial cybersecurity investments are associated with higher financial risk, but risk declines once investment surpasses a critical threshold, underscoring the importance of investment scale and maturity. Board experience heterogeneity moderates this curvilinear effect, enabling better risk governance and decision-making. These findings challenge prevailing linear assumptions and underscore the strategic importance of governance in enhancing the effectiveness of cybersecurity investments, advancing research on cybersecurity investment and corporate governance, and providing empirical support for integrating these investments into enterprise risk management.

AI.tldr: 网络安全投资与企业财务风险呈倒U型关系：初期投资增加风险，超过临界点后降低风险。董事会经验异质性调节这一关系，治理机制对投资有效性至关重要。
AI.research_question: 网络安全投资如何影响企业财务风险？董事会治理机制如何调节这种关系？
AI.motivation: 尽管企业网络安全投资大幅增加，但网络安全威胁加剧，企业财务风险持续上升，引发了对网络安全投资有效性的质疑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合信号理论和同质性概念，从公司治理视角分析网络安全投资与风险关系。
AI.method: 使用2011-2020年1,071家企业的面板数据（7,892个企业-年度观测值），实证检验网络安全投资与财务风险的非线性关系。
AI.findings: 发现倒U型关系：初期网络安全投资与更高财务风险相关，但投资超过临界阈值后风险下降。董事会经验异质性调节这一曲线效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了线性假设，推进网络安全投资与公司治理研究，为将网络安全投资纳入企业风险管理提供理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调投资规模和成熟度的重要性，董事会治理在增强网络安全投资有效性中的战略作用，为企业风险管理实践提供指导。

title: Short-Term Incentive Effects and Persistent Information Effects: Evidence from a TIS Field Experiment on Commuting Behavior
affiliations: , University of Groningen, Peking University, University of Leeds, University of Leeds and Beijing Jiaotong University

detail.title: Short-Term Incentive Effects and Persistent Information Effects: Evidence from a TIS Field Experiment on Commuting Behavior

declarations.ethicsApproval: This project underwent ethics review by the SBE Research Ethical Review Board at Vrije University Amsterdam. The experiment reported in this paper are registered at the AEA Random Control Trial Registry, numbers AEARCTR-0006857.

detail.abstract: Transportation information systems (TIS) have become widely used digital platforms for managing urban mobility and provide a natural infrastructure for delivering interventions aimed at reducing traffic congestion. Leveraging this system, we design financial and non-financial TIS-delivered interventions and conduct a 26-week randomized field experiment with 313 Beijing drivers. Using high-frequency, objective driving records collected through the TIS, we estimate the causal effects of congestion charges and health-based informational nudges on morning peak-hour driving. Congestion charges reduce peak-hour departures immediately, but the effect dissipates once the financial incentive is removed. In contrast, weekly health information generates a delayed yet more persistent response, lasting for seven weeks after the intervention ends, and reducing overall morning commuting rather than merely shifting departure times. When financial and informational interventions are delivered jointly, response patterns resemble those of congestion charges, suggesting that financial incentives dominate information-based nudges when offered together. To explain the persistence of informational effects, we develop a travel-choice model integrating health utility with an attention-stock mechanism, showing how repeated health messages delivered via the TIS accumulate durable health-related attention that shapes habits.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过北京313名司机的26周随机实地实验，比较了交通信息系统(TIS)提供的拥堵收费和健康信息干预对早高峰驾驶的影响。拥堵收费能立即减少高峰出行但效果短暂，而每周健康信息虽反应延迟但效果持久，可持续7周。当两者结合时，财务激励主导了干预效果。
AI.research_question: 交通信息系统(TIS)提供的财务激励（拥堵收费）和非财务干预（健康信息推送）如何影响司机的早高峰驾驶行为？哪种干预效果更持久？当两者结合时会产生什么交互效应？
AI.motivation: 交通拥堵是城市面临的重要挑战，交通信息系统已成为管理城市流动性的数字平台，但如何利用这一基础设施有效实施干预措施来减少交通拥堵仍缺乏实证研究。需要比较不同类型干预措施的效果和持续性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合健康效用和注意力存量机制，构建旅行选择模型。该模型解释重复的健康信息如何通过TIS积累持久的健康相关注意力，从而改变驾驶习惯。
AI.method: 26周随机实地实验，313名北京司机参与。使用TIS收集的高频客观驾驶记录数据。实验设计包括：拥堵收费组、健康信息推送组、组合干预组和对照组。通过随机分配比较不同干预的因果效应。
AI.findings: 1. 拥堵收费能立即减少高峰出行，但效果短暂，激励移除后即消失；2. 每周健康信息产生延迟但更持久的反应，干预结束后可持续7周，且减少整体早高峰通勤而非仅改变出发时间；3. 当财务和信息干预结合时，反应模式类似拥堵收费，表明财务激励在组合中占主导地位。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了整合健康效用和注意力存量机制的旅行选择模型，解释了信息干预的持久性效应。理论贡献在于阐明了重复信息如何通过积累注意力存量来改变长期行为习惯。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市交通管理者提供了实证依据：健康信息推送比拥堵收费具有更持久的行为改变效果。建议在TIS平台上实施定期健康信息干预来减少高峰拥堵，而非仅依赖财务激励。当需要立即效果时可使用财务激励，但需注意其短暂性。

title: Five Decades of State Capacity Research: Theoretical Shifts, Empirical Patterns and New Directions for Public Administration
affiliations: Tribhuvan University

detail.title: Five Decades of State Capacity Research: Theoretical Shifts, Empirical Patterns and New Directions for Public Administration
detail.abstract: This article synthesizes fifty years of scholarship on state capacity to clarify its conceptual evolution, map empirical patterns, and propose a future research agenda for public administration. Using a systematic and integrative review of peer-reviewed literature from 1975–2025 across major databases, studies were coded and analyzed temporally, thematically, and methodologically. The review identifies five waves of research, from early emphasis on autonomy and extraction to contemporary focus on sectoral performance, digital governance, and crisis management. Empirical findings show increasing methodological pluralism, a shift from macro-indices to organizational and micro-level studies, and growing attention to subnational and sector-specific capacities. Persistent tensions exist between technocratic and political interpretations of capacity. The article reconceptualizes state capacity as a multidimensional construct integrating bureaucratic performance, institutional embeddedness, and societal legitimacy. Findings inform administrative reform, public service delivery, crisis governance, and capacity-building, offering a structured framework to guide future research and practice in public administration.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统回顾了1975-2025年间关于国家能力的学术研究，识别了五个研究浪潮，从早期的自主性和汲取能力转向当代的部门绩效、数字治理和危机管理。研究揭示了方法论多元化、从宏观指数转向组织微观研究、以及关注次国家和部门特定能力的趋势。文章将国家能力重新概念化为整合官僚绩效、制度嵌入性和社会合法性的多维建构。
AI.research_question: 国家能力概念在过去五十年中如何演变？其经验研究模式和方法论发展呈现什么趋势？未来公共行政领域关于国家能力的研究议程应如何构建？
AI.motivation: 国家能力是公共行政和比较政治学的核心概念，但现有研究分散且概念模糊，缺乏系统性整合。需要澄清其概念演变、映射经验模式，并为未来研究提供结构化框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国家能力理论、官僚政治理论、制度主义理论、治理理论。文章整合了技术官僚和政治解释两种视角，提出了多维度的国家能力建构框架。
AI.method: 采用系统性整合性文献综述方法，对1975-2025年间同行评审文献进行编码分析，包括时间分析、主题分析和方法论分析。
AI.findings:
1. 识别了五个研究浪潮：自主性与汲取能力→制度能力→治理能力→部门绩效→数字治理与危机管理
2. 方法论日益多元化，从宏观指数转向组织和微观层面研究
3. 关注点从国家层面扩展到次国家和部门特定能力
4. 技术官僚解释与政治解释之间存在持续张力
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 重新概念化国家能力为整合官僚绩效、制度嵌入性和社会合法性的多维建构
2. 提供了国家能力研究的系统化历史演变框架
3. 揭示了概念演变与经验研究模式之间的关系
4. 提出了整合技术官僚和政治视角的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为行政改革提供指导框架
2. 改善公共服务提供
3. 增强危机治理能力
4. 指导能力建设实践
5. 为政策制定者和实践者提供结构化工具

title: A Decision-Support Framework for Phased Digital Transformation in Process Industries: Integrating Multi-Capital Value, Maturity, and Functional Dependencies
affiliations: Tarbiat Modares University, Tarbiat Modares University, University of Queensland and Tarbiat Modares University

detail.title: A Decision-Support Framework for Phased Digital Transformation in Process Industries: Integrating Multi-Capital Value, Maturity, and Functional Dependencies
detail.abstract: Digital transformation in process industries is widely recognized as a strategic priority, yet organizations frequently struggle to determine which digital initiatives to implement, when to implement them, and how to sequence investments under limited resources and uncertain returns. Existing digitalization roadmaps often rely on narrow financial or technical criteria and provide limited guidance on implementation phasing, while overlooking sustainability value creation, organizational readiness, and functional interdependencies. This study proposes an integrated decision-support framework to guide the phased implementation of digital transformation initiatives in process-oriented industries. The proposed framework combines multi-capital value assessment, maturity-based capability analysis, and dependency modeling within a unified multi-criteria decision-making structure. Functional benefits are evaluated using the Six-Capital model to capture financial, human, social, manufactured, natural, and intellectual value, with capital weights derived using the Best–Worst Method. Organizational readiness is assessed through a four-pillar maturity analysis covering people, data, systems, and processes, while implementation cost and time are estimated using expert-informed field data. Functional interdependencies are explicitly modeled using DEMATEL to distinguish prerequisite and dependent capabilities. These dimensions are subsequently integrated using a Fuzzy TOPSIS approach to derive an actionable, phased digital transformation roadmap. The framework is demonstrated through an application in a small-scale mineral processing pilot plant, illustrating that foundational capabilities—such as data infrastructure, connectivity, and scalable control platforms—must be prioritized early to enable higher-order analytics and automation. Sensitivity analysis confirms the robustness of the prioritization results across varying decision-weight scenarios. By integrating sustainability-aligned value creation, organizational maturity, and dependency-aware sequencing, the proposed framework provides managers with a systematic and risk-aware tool for designing realistic digital transformation pathways. While demonstrated in a process-industry context, the approach is generalizable to other manufacturing and asset-intensive sectors.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一个集成决策支持框架，用于指导流程导向行业的数字化转型计划分阶段实施。该框架结合了多资本价值评估、基于成熟度的能力分析和依赖关系建模，通过模糊TOPSIS方法生成可操作的、分阶段的数字化转型路线图。
AI.research_question: 如何为流程导向行业设计一个系统化的、分阶段的数字化转型路线图，该路线图应综合考虑可持续价值创造、组织准备度和功能相互依赖性？
AI.motivation: 数字化转型在流程行业被广泛认为是战略重点，但组织经常难以确定实施哪些数字计划、何时实施以及如何在有限资源和不确定回报下安排投资顺序。现有的数字化路线图通常依赖狭隘的财务或技术标准，对实施阶段提供有限指导，同时忽视了可持续价值创造、组织准备度和功能相互依赖性。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 六资本模型（Six-Capital model）：评估财务、人力、社会、制造、自然和智力价值
2. 最佳-最差方法（Best-Worst Method）：确定资本权重
3. DEMATEL方法：建模功能相互依赖性，区分先决条件和依赖能力
4. 模糊TOPSIS方法：集成多维度评估，生成优先排序
AI.method:
1. 多资本价值评估：使用六资本模型评估功能效益
2. 成熟度分析：通过人员、数据、系统和流程四个支柱评估组织准备度
3. 依赖关系建模：使用DEMATEL方法明确建模功能相互依赖性
4. 成本和时间估计：使用专家知情的现场数据
5. 集成决策：使用模糊TOPSIS方法整合所有维度
6. 案例研究：在小型矿物加工试验工厂应用框架
7. 敏感性分析：验证不同决策权重情景下的稳健性
AI.findings:
1. 基础能力（如数据基础设施、连接性和可扩展控制平台）必须优先实施，以支持高阶分析和自动化
2. 敏感性分析证实了优先排序结果在不同决策权重情景下的稳健性
3. 该框架为管理者提供了系统化和风险感知的工具，用于设计现实的数字化转型路径
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了一个集成的决策支持框架，将可持续价值创造、组织成熟度和依赖关系感知的排序相结合
2. 将六资本模型、DEMATEL和模糊TOPSIS方法创新性地应用于数字化转型路线图设计
3. 为流程行业的数字化转型研究提供了新的理论视角和方法论工具
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为管理者提供了系统化的工具，用于设计现实的数字化转型路线图
2. 帮助组织在有限资源和不确定回报下做出更好的投资决策
3. 确保数字化转型不仅考虑财务价值，还考虑可持续性和组织能力
4. 框架可推广到其他制造和资产密集型行业

title: Integrated Optimization of Scheduling and Flexible Charging in Mixed Electric-Diesel Urban Transit Bus Systems
affiliations: University of Illinois Chicago, Government of the United States of America - Argonne National Laboratory, Government of the United States of America - Argonne National Laboratory and University of Illinois at Chicago

detail.title: Integrated Optimization of Scheduling and Flexible Charging in Mixed Electric-Diesel Urban Transit Bus Systems
detail.abstract: The transition of transit fleets to alternative powertrains offers a potential pathway to reducing the cost of mobility. However, the limited range and long charging durations of battery electric buses (BEBs) introduce significant operational complexities, necessitating innovative scheduling and charging strategies. This study proposes an integrated mixed-integer linear programming model to optimize vehicle scheduling and charging strategies for mixed fleets of BEBs and diesel buses. Unlike existing models, which often assume a fixed BEB fleet size or restrict charging to a single charger type, our approach simultaneously determines the optimal fleet composition, scheduling, and flexible partial charging strategy incorporating both slow and fast chargers at garages and terminal stations. The model minimizes combined fleet purchase and operational costs. A queuing strategy is introduced, departing from traditional first-come, first-served methods by dynamically allocating waiting and charging times based on operational priorities and resource availability, improving overall scheduling efficiency. To overcome computational complexities arising from numerous variables, a column generation framework is developed, facilitating scalable solutions for large-scale transit networks. Numerical experiments using real-world transit data from the Chicago Transit Authority and the Pace suburban bus systems demonstrate the model's effectiveness. Results indicate that while a full transition to alternative powertrains results in a modest cost increase, optimal mixed-fleet configurations can actually reduce total system costs. Furthermore, sensitivity analyses reveal that restricting charging to garages significantly increases fleet size and operational costs, underscoring the potential of distributed opportunistic charging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出混合整数线性规划模型，优化电池电动巴士与柴油巴士混合车队的调度与充电策略，采用列生成算法解决计算复杂度，通过芝加哥真实数据验证模型有效性，发现最优混合车队配置可降低总成本。
AI.research_question: 如何优化混合动力巴士车队（电池电动巴士与柴油巴士）的车辆调度和充电策略，以最小化总系统成本？
AI.motivation: 公交车队向替代动力系统转型可降低出行成本，但电池电动巴士的有限续航和长充电时间带来运营复杂性，需要创新的调度和充电策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合整数线性规划理论、列生成算法、排队理论（非传统先到先服务，基于运营优先级和资源可用性的动态分配）
AI.method: 集成混合整数线性规划模型，同时确定最优车队组成、调度和灵活部分充电策略（包含车库和终点站的慢充和快充），采用列生成框架解决大规模变量计算复杂度。
AI.findings: 1. 完全转型为替代动力系统会导致成本小幅增加；2. 最优混合车队配置可降低总系统成本；3. 限制在车库充电会显著增加车队规模和运营成本，分布式机会充电具有潜力。

AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为公交运营商提供混合车队优化工具；2. 证明混合车队配置的经济可行性；3. 展示分布式充电策略的运营优势；4. 基于芝加哥真实数据的验证为实际应用提供参考。

title: Introducing Soviet Union's Planned Economy: China's First Five-Year Plan Achieved Brilliant Accomplishments
affiliations: , College of Economics and Management, Kashi University,  and

detail.title: Introducing Soviet Union's Planned Economy: China's First Five-Year Plan Achieved Brilliant Accomplishments
detail.abstract: The planned economic system in the Stalin period is of great significance in the whole economic development history of the Soviet Union. Summarize the research results of the planned economic system in this period can also be a reference for China's economic system reform in the new era. This paper examines the profound influence of the Soviet Union's planned economy on the formulation, implementation, and success of New China's First Five-Year Plan. Drawing upon an extensive review of the key Chinese studies and influential Western works, the paper analyzes the Soviet centralized planning system and the Soviet support to New China's ambitious development program. The research explores; the main achievements of the Soviet planned economy; the multifaceted factors that drove New China to adopt and adapt these methods; the detailed process including Soviet intervention of formulating and adjusting the First Five-Year Plan; the key statistical data that confirm the completion of main economic indicators; the lasting impact of the plan on China's economic development prior to reform and opening up; the critical discussion on China's experience and shortcomings in implementing the planed economy and the insights drawn from quantitative studies assessing the relationship between Soviet aid and 1 The paper is presented at the 82nd MPSA Annual Conference in Chicago in April 2025 China's industrial output. These findings suggest that while Soviet planning techniques and its assistance were instrumental in achieving rapid industrial construction, the rigid transplanting of foreign models also created structural challenges that later required reform. This study thus contributes to our understanding of early Sino-Soviet economic cooperation and the foundational role of state-led planning in China's modernization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了斯大林时期苏联计划经济体制对新中国"一五"计划制定、实施和成功的深远影响，分析了苏联集中计划体制及其对新中国发展项目的支持，探讨了苏联计划经济的成就、中国采用这些方法的多重因素、"一五"计划的制定调整过程、主要经济指标完成情况、对改革开放前中国经济发展的持久影响，以及苏联援助与中国工业产出关系的定量研究。

AI.motivation: 斯大林时期的计划经济体制在苏联经济发展史上具有重要意义，总结这一时期计划经济体制的研究成果，可以为新时代中国经济体制改革提供借鉴。

title: Toward an ILP approach of temporal Coverage in Sensor Networks
affiliations: University of Oran 1 Ahmed Ben Bella, ,  and

detail.title: Toward an ILP approach of temporal Coverage in Sensor Networks
detail.abstract: Energy has long been a critical concern in the deployment of outdoor monitoring systems based on sensor networks, particularly when sensors are difficult to access. Energyneutral sensors offer a promising solution, but they introduce additional challenges, notably the need to maintain temporal coverage in the presence of energy shortages.This work addresses the problem of ensuring temporal continuity in monitoring by orchestrating the activation and charging cycles of multiple sensors to guarantee continuous temporal and spatial coverage. We investigate two distinct approaches based on Integer Linear Programming (ILP). In the first approach, once a sensor is activated, it continuously monitors until its battery level reaches a predefined energy threshold. In the second approach, the monitoring and charging phases of a sensor may be interrupted. These approaches present different trade-offs in terms of sensor-side implementation complexity, solving time, and solution optimality. We evaluate their performance through an extensive set of synthetic experiments.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过整数线性规划方法解决能量中性传感器网络中的连续时空覆盖问题，提出了两种不同的传感器激活与充电调度策略，并在复杂性和最优性之间进行权衡分析。
AI.research_question: 如何通过协调多个传感器的激活和充电周期来确保能量中性传感器网络中的连续时空覆盖？
AI.motivation: 户外监测系统中的能量管理是关键挑战，特别是当传感器难以访问时。能量中性传感器虽然提供了解决方案，但在能量短缺情况下维持时间连续性覆盖带来了新的挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于整数线性规划（ILP）的优化理论框架，用于解决传感器网络中的调度和资源分配问题。
AI.method: 提出两种基于整数线性规划的方法：1）传感器激活后持续监测直到达到能量阈值；2）允许监测和充电阶段被中断。通过大量合成实验评估性能。
AI.findings: 两种方法在传感器端实现复杂性、求解时间和解决方案最优性方面存在不同的权衡关系。实验结果表明了不同策略在不同场景下的适用性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为能量中性传感器网络中的连续时空覆盖问题提供了形式化的数学建模框架，提出了两种基于ILP的优化方法，丰富了无线传感器网络调度理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为户外监测系统的设计和部署提供了实用的调度策略，帮助系统设计者在实现复杂性和性能之间做出权衡决策，提高系统可靠性和能效。

title: Bayesian Persuasion with Selective Disclosure
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and Northwestern University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Bayesian Persuasion with Selective Disclosure
detail.abstract: A sender first publicly commits to an experiment and then can privately run additional experiments and selectively disclose their outcomes to a receiver. The sender has private information about the maximal number of additional experiments they can perform (i.e., their type). We show that the sender cannot attain their commitment payoff in any equilibrium if (i) the receiver is sufficiently uncertain about their type and (ii) the sender could benefit from selective disclosure after conducting their full-commitment optimal experiment. Otherwise, there can be equilibria where the sender obtains their commitment payoff.

AI.tldr: 发送者先公开承诺一个实验，然后可以私下进行额外实验并选择性地向接收者披露结果。发送者拥有关于自己能进行额外实验最大数量的私有信息（类型）。研究表明，当接收者对发送者类型足够不确定，且发送者在进行完全承诺最优实验后能从选择性披露中获益时，发送者无法在任何均衡中获得承诺收益。否则，可能存在发送者获得承诺收益的均衡。
AI.research_question: 在发送者先公开承诺实验，然后可以私下进行额外实验并选择性披露结果的情境下，发送者何时能够获得其承诺收益？
AI.motivation: 研究信息设计中的承诺问题，特别是当发送者拥有关于自己实验能力的私有信息时，如何影响其信息传递策略和收益。

AI.method: 理论建模分析，构建发送者-接收者博弈模型，分析均衡条件
AI.findings: 1. 当接收者对发送者类型足够不确定，且发送者在进行完全承诺最优实验后能从选择性披露中获益时，发送者无法在任何均衡中获得承诺收益。2. 否则，可能存在发送者获得承诺收益的均衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了信息设计理论，考虑了发送者实验能力的私有信息。2. 揭示了承诺收益实现的条件限制。3. 为选择性披露策略提供了理论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为实际中的信息披露策略提供指导。2. 帮助理解在信息不对称情况下如何设计实验和披露策略。3. 对政策制定者和企业信息披露实践有启示意义。

title: A Study on the Management Model and Reform Path of the SOEs in New China and the Former Soviet Union
affiliations: , , College of Economics and Management, Kashi University and College of Economics and Management, Kashi University

detail.title: A Study on the Management Model and Reform Path of the SOEs in New China and the Former Soviet Union
detail.abstract: This paper examines and compares the evolution, management models, and reform paths of state-owned enterprises (SOEs) in China and the Soviet Union during the formative periods preceding the collapse of the Soviet regime. Drawing on an extensive review of both Chinese and Western literature, the study analyzes the historical processes that led to the formation of SOEs, their structural characteristics, and their economic contributions. Key statistical data are used to illustrate the roles of these enterprises in their respective national economies. Furthermore, the paper discusses the experiences and lessons learned from the evolution of SOEs in both countries and evaluates the similarities and differences in their development strategies. Finally, the paper explores how the legacy of SOE management influenced subsequent reform and opening-up policies in China and the later restructuring attempts in the Soviet Union.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了中苏两国在苏联解体前形成时期的国有企业演变、管理模式和改革路径，分析了历史进程、结构特征、经济贡献，并探讨了国企管理遗产对后续改革政策的影响。

AI.theoretical_framework: 国有企业理论、比较制度分析、历史制度主义、转型经济学、计划经济向市场经济转型理论。
AI.method: 文献综述法（中西方文献）、历史比较分析、统计数据分析、案例比较研究。

title: The Major Achievements of Soviet Union's Economic Development (1945-1953)
affiliations: Kashi University, Kashi university, College of Economics and Management, Kashi University and

detail.title: The Major Achievements of Soviet Union's Economic Development (1945-1953)
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the outstanding economic and scientific-technological achievements of the Soviet Union during the 1945-1953 period and analyzes how these successes influenced New China's decision to adopt the Soviet development model. Drawing upon a review of the key Chinese studies and the influential Western works, this study synthesizes diverse research methods, including historical institutional analysis, archival research, and econometric modeling, to examine the driving forces behind Soviet economic development, its quantitative achievements, and its evolving international status relative to the United States. Moreover, the paper reviews the development of Sino-Soviet relations during both the Kuomintang era and the early years of the People's Republic of China, and it provides a comprehensive factor analysis of why New China chose to introduce the "Soviet model." The paper also discusses recent quantitative research that employs statistical models to assess the impact of Soviet achievements on China's economic planning. The findings underscore that the rapid reconstruction and modernization of the Soviet economy not only set new benchmarks in industrial output and scientific progress but also provided a persuasive example that shaped China's early development strategy.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了苏联在1945-1953年间的经济科技成就如何影响新中国选择苏联发展模式，通过历史制度分析、档案研究和计量模型等方法，揭示了苏联成功经验对中国早期发展战略的示范作用。

title: EVOLUTION OF MATURITY MODELS IN DIGITAL TRANSFORMATION: AN INTEGRATIVE REVIEW ON THE SHIFT FROM TECHNOLOGICAL TO ORGANIZATIONAL DIMENSIONS

detail.title: EVOLUTION OF MATURITY MODELS IN DIGITAL TRANSFORMATION: AN INTEGRATIVE REVIEW ON THE SHIFT FROM TECHNOLOGICAL TO ORGANIZATIONAL DIMENSIONS
detail.abstract: The Fourth Industrial Revolution has intensified structural transformations across economic sectors by integrating emerging digital technologies with evolving business models and organizational processes. In this context, digital transformation (DT) has become a strategic imperative rather than a discretionary competitive advantage. Despite their economic relevance, Brazilian companies face persistent barriers to DT, including limited financial resources, reduced technological capabilities, low managerial maturity, and the absence of structured strategic guidance.,This article addresses these challenges by conducting an integrative literature review of digital maturity models, with the objective of analyzing the conceptual evolution of their dimensions and identifying a clear shift from a predominantly technological focus toward organizational, cultural, and strategic perspectives. The results reveal significant gaps in existing models, particularly regarding their adaptability to the structural, cultural, and economic realities of companies in emerging economies.,Building on these findings, the article proposes a structured maturity index, designed to support DT assessments, prioritization of initiatives, and guided implementation of DT. Conceptually aligned with multiple digital maturity pathways, the methodology integrates maturity assessment tools, action-oriented planning, and governance mechanisms aimed at improving operational efficiency, enhancing customer value creation, and fostering sustainable competitiveness.,By bridging theory and practice, this research contributes to the advancement of digital maturity literature and offers a practical, context-sensitive framework to support companies in navigating their digital transformation journeys within Industry 4.0.

title: Asymmetric Factor Volatility During COVID-19: Evidence for EGARCH over GARCH
affiliations: ESSEC Business School

detail.title: Asymmetric Factor Volatility During COVID-19: Evidence for EGARCH over GARCH
detail.abstract: Slides for the paper "Asymmetric Factor Volatility During COVID-19: Evidence for EGARCH over GARCH". This paper documents a critical market inefficiency in factor-level volatility forecasting during systemic crises. Traditional symmetric GARCH(1,1) models, despite effectively capturing autocorrelation dynamics, systematically misspecify factor-level risk through two mechanisms: (1) violation of normality assumptions creating extreme fat tails, and (2) asymmetric shock responses. Analysing five US equity factors (Size, Value, Quality, Momentum, Minimum Volatility) and the S&P 500 Index from November 2019 to December 2021, we find: (1) all factors exhibit significant asymmetric volatility drifts (γ = 0.388-0.554, p < 0.05), with defensive factors showing stronger asymmetry than Value; (2) GARCH systematically underpredicts tail volatility by 40-260 basis points during crisis peaks; (3) EGARCH reduces this misspecification by 20% when forecasting the Momentum factor and show overconfidence in prediction when assessing market aggregate (S&P 500) with statistically significant out-of-sample improvements (p < 0.001). The finding that defensive factors do not escape asymmetric responses challenges conventional portfolio diversification wisdom. The findings presented in this paper suggest practitioners consider alternative models to capture volatility such as EGARCH compared to standard Gaussian GARCH model.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，在COVID-19危机期间，传统对称GARCH模型在因子层面波动率预测中存在系统性误判，而EGARCH模型能更好地捕捉不对称冲击响应，特别是对动量因子和市场总体的预测有显著改进。
AI.research_question: 在系统性危机期间，传统对称GARCH模型在因子层面波动率预测中是否存在系统性误判？EGARCH模型是否能更有效地捕捉不对称冲击响应并改进预测精度？
AI.motivation: 传统GARCH模型在正常市场条件下表现良好，但在COVID-19等系统性危机期间，市场表现出极端尾部风险和不对称冲击响应，这可能导致因子层面波动率预测的系统性误判，影响投资组合管理和风险管理决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于波动率建模理论，特别是GARCH家族模型（对称GARCH vs 不对称EGARCH），结合因子投资理论和风险管理框架，分析市场危机期间因子层面的波动率动态。
AI.method: 实证分析五个美国股票因子（规模、价值、质量、动量、最小波动率）和标普500指数从2019年11月至2021年12月的数据，比较GARCH(1,1)和EGARCH模型的预测性能，包括参数估计、样本内拟合和样本外预测检验。
AI.findings: 1. 所有因子都表现出显著的不对称波动率漂移（γ=0.388-0.554）；2. 防御性因子比价值因子表现出更强的不对称性；3. GARCH在危机峰值期间系统性低估尾部波动率40-260个基点；4. EGARCH对动量因子的误判减少20%，对标普500的预测有统计显著的样本外改进。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战传统投资组合分散化智慧，证明防御性因子在危机期间也无法避免不对称冲击响应；为因子层面波动率建模提供理论改进，强调不对称性在危机期间的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议从业者考虑使用EGARCH等替代模型来捕捉波动率不对称性，特别是在危机期间；为风险管理、投资组合构建和因子投资策略提供更准确的波动率预测工具。

title: Dynamic Modelling and Reinforcement Learning-Based Control of Building Energy Supply Systems for Enhanced Efficiency and Indoor Comfort
affiliations: Tsinghua University

detail.title: Dynamic Modelling and Reinforcement Learning-Based Control of Building Energy Supply Systems for Enhanced Efficiency and Indoor Comfort
detail.abstract: The primary goal of this endeavour is to enhance the modelling of energy supply systems, thereby improving the regulation of building temperatures and energy efficiency. To better optimise building engineering systems and thermal regimes, our study aims to elucidate how new smart control approaches and dynamic modelling tools can achieve this. Improving a building's occupants' comfort via the use of more energy and resources may lead to higher expenses without a guarantee of reduced emissions. To achieve optimal interior temperature control and energy efficiency, this research aims to model the various working modes of energy systems. Dynamic models are created using Python and MATLAB/Simscape to showcase different controller schemes and component systems. In particular, RL-based controllers exhibit adaptive load management, which has the potential to reduce power usage by 35% in real-time, 50% in response to temperature changes, and 1% overall, all while maintaining comfort. In situations when the energy supply is continuous, RL-based heat controls are helpful in managing overheating and inconsistent temperatures. Researchers and professionals in the field may find value in the proposed energy-dynamic building model because it facilitates the modelling, evaluation, and optimisation of various energy supply systems to enhance indoor environmental quality and achieve sustainable energy performance.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过开发基于强化学习的智能控制器和动态建模工具，优化建筑能源系统，在保持舒适度的同时实现能耗降低（实时35%、温度响应50%、总体1%）。
AI.research_question: 如何通过智能控制方法和动态建模工具优化建筑能源系统，实现温度调节和能源效率的提升？
AI.motivation: 传统建筑温度调节往往通过增加能源消耗来提升舒适度，导致成本上升且不一定减少碳排放。需要更智能的方法在保持舒适度的同时优化能源使用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于强化学习（RL）的智能控制理论，动态系统建模理论，建筑热工学和能源管理系统理论。
AI.method: 使用Python和MATLAB/Simscape创建动态模型，开发基于强化学习的控制器方案，模拟不同能源系统工作模式，进行实时控制和温度响应测试。
AI.findings: RL控制器能实现自适应负荷管理：实时能耗降低35%，温度响应能耗降低50%，总体能耗降低1%，同时保持舒适度。在连续供能情况下能有效管理过热和不稳定温度问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于强化学习的建筑能源动态控制理论框架，发展了智能建筑温度调节的建模方法，为建筑能源系统的自适应优化提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了实用的能源动态建筑模型工具，支持不同能源系统的建模、评估和优化；RL控制器方案可直接应用于实际建筑管理系统，提升室内环境质量和能源可持续性。

title: Price-Based Carbon Policy with Energy Storage
affiliations: Stockholm University - Department of Computer and Systems Sciences and Carnegie Mellon University

detail.title: Price-Based Carbon Policy with Energy Storage
detail.abstract: Policymakers are contending with designing mechanisms to decarbonize electricity systems. Economic theory suggests that, subject to a number of structural assumptions, price-based mechanisms can be economically efficient means of achieving such goals. This paper examines the interplay among price-based carbon policy, market structure, and energy storage. Using a stylized two-period model and a Stackelberg framework, we compare a first-best central-planning solution to market outcomes if there is a perfectly competitive generation sector or if market power is exercised by the carbon-based-generation sector. A price-based mechanism can signal the social cost of carbon to carbon-based generation by increasing the private cost of emissions equally during all time periods. However, it distorts the incentives for efficient energy-storage use vis-à-vis a first-best central-planning outcome. Interestingly, this distortion persists even with a perfectly competitive electricity-supply sector, as energystorage output shifts toward the off-peak period. Somewhat counterintuitively, a market structure wherein carbon-based generation exercises market power can yield an outcome that is closer to first best than perfect competition does, due to the propensity of the carbonbased generator to withhold its output to exercise market power, thereby attenuating the temporal incentive of energy-storage operations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于价格的碳政策、市场结构和储能之间的相互作用，发现碳价机制虽然能反映碳排放的社会成本，但会扭曲储能的有效使用激励，且这种扭曲在完全竞争市场中依然存在。有趣的是，当碳基发电商行使市场势力时，结果反而更接近最优中央规划。
AI.research_question: 基于价格的碳政策如何与市场结构和储能相互作用？碳价机制在完全竞争和市场势力条件下对储能使用效率有何影响？
AI.motivation: 政策制定者需要设计机制来实现电力系统脱碳。经济理论表明，在特定结构假设下，基于价格的机制可以是实现这一目标的经济有效手段。然而，碳政策、市场结构和储能之间的复杂相互作用需要深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用两期模型和Stackelberg博弈框架，比较最优中央规划方案与市场结果（包括完全竞争发电部门和碳基发电部门行使市场势力的情形）。
AI.method: 使用简化的两期模型和Stackelberg博弈框架进行分析，比较不同市场结构下的结果。
AI.findings: 1. 基于价格的碳政策虽然能将碳排放的社会成本信号传递给碳基发电，但在所有时间段平等增加排放的私人成本会扭曲储能的有效使用激励。2. 这种扭曲即使在完全竞争的电力供应部门中仍然存在，导致储能输出向非高峰时段转移。3. 反直觉的是，当碳基发电商行使市场势力时，结果反而更接近最优中央规划，因为碳基发电商为行使市场势力而限制产出，从而减弱了储能运营的时间激励。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了基于价格的碳政策对储能使用激励的扭曲效应。2. 挑战了完全竞争市场必然更有效率的传统观念，发现在特定条件下市场势力可能改善结果。3. 提供了碳政策、市场结构和储能相互作用的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者设计碳政策时考虑储能影响提供指导。2. 提醒监管机构注意碳政策可能产生的意外后果，特别是对储能运营的扭曲。3. 建议在评估碳政策效果时需要综合考虑市场结构和储能技术特性。

title: Testing the Great Ratios Hypothesis with Minimum Distance Estimation under Weak Assumptions
affiliations: University of Nottingham, Ningbo - University of Nottingham Ningbo China and Korea University

detail.title: Testing the Great Ratios Hypothesis with Minimum Distance Estimation under Weak Assumptions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There is no conflict of interest to disclose.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human/animal subject is involved in this research.

detail.abstract: The macro-economic literature found little evidence for the great ratios hypothesis (GRH) that certain ratios of long-run elasticities are unity, until the 'System Pooled Mean Group (SPMG)' estimator pooled long-run elasticities across equations and countries. However, SPMG does not test whether pooling was coherent with the data. In this paper, we use bivariate unrestricted error correction models to estimate equation- and country-specific ratios. Then we test for the poolability, using Minimum Distance Estimator (MDE). The test supports GRH mostly, and the MDE-pooled ratios are 0.9 ~ 1.1 for 6/8 relationships (except for inflation-involved ratios).

AI.tldr: 本文使用双变量无约束误差修正模型估计方程和国家特定比率，通过最小距离估计器检验可合并性，发现大部分支持大比率假说，6/8关系的MDE合并比率在0.9~1.1之间（通胀相关比率除外）。
AI.research_question: 大比率假说（GRH）是否成立？通过检验长期弹性的可合并性来验证GRH的有效性。
AI.motivation: 先前宏观经济学文献发现大比率假说（GRH）证据不足，直到"系统合并均值组（SPMG）"估计器出现，但SPMG未检验合并是否与数据一致。
AI.theoretical_framework: 大比率假说（GRH）、误差修正模型、最小距离估计器（MDE）、可合并性检验。
AI.method: 使用双变量无约束误差修正模型估计方程和国家特定比率，然后使用最小距离估计器（MDE）检验可合并性。
AI.findings: 检验结果大部分支持GRH，MDE合并比率在0.9~1.1之间（6/8个关系），通胀相关比率除外。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了检验GRH的新方法，通过可合并性检验验证了SPMG估计器的有效性，为GRH提供了更可靠的证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为宏观经济学家提供了验证GRH的实证工具，有助于理解长期经济关系，对政策制定有参考价值。

title: Extrapolative Beliefs and Financial Decisions: Causal Evidence from Renewable Energy Financing
affiliations: Tsinghua University - PBC School of Finance, Fudan University, Renmin University of China and National University of Singapore (NUS)

detail.title: Extrapolative Beliefs and Financial Decisions: Causal Evidence from Renewable Energy Financing
detail.abstract: How do expectation biases causally affect households' financial decisions? We exploit a unique setting and study the repayment decision in solar loans, in which households borrow to purchase and install solar photovoltaic (PV) systems. Electricity production—the benefit that solar panels generate—primarily depends on sunshine duration. This creates exogenous within-person across-period variation in recent signals that borrowers observe and thereby expectations of future electricity production. We find that a one-standard-deviation decrease in sunshine duration in the week right before the repayment date leads to a 22% increase of delinquency, even though deviated past sunshine duration does not predict that in the future. Survey evidence shows that agents make more positive forecasts of future electricity production after experiencing longer sunshine duration in the past week. We examine a battery of alternative explanations and rule out mechanisms based on liquidity constraints and wealth effects.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，家庭在太阳能贷款还款决策中受到期望偏差的影响：还款前一周日照时间减少一个标准差会导致违约率增加22%，尽管过去的日照偏差并不能预测未来。调查显示，人们会根据过去一周的日照情况对未来发电量做出有偏差的预测。
AI.research_question: 期望偏差如何因果性地影响家庭的财务决策？
AI.motivation: 理解期望偏差在家庭财务决策中的作用，特别是在太阳能贷款这种特殊情境下，可以揭示行为经济学在现实金融决策中的重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学中的期望偏差理论，特别是可得性启发式和代表性启发式，以及它们在家庭金融决策中的应用。
AI.method: 利用太阳能贷款的特殊情境，通过日照时间的自然变化创造外生冲击，分析还款前一周日照时间变化对违约率的影响。同时使用调查数据验证期望形成机制。
AI.findings: 还款前一周日照时间减少一个标准差会导致违约率增加22%；人们会根据过去一周的日照情况对未来发电量做出有偏差的预测；排除了流动性约束和财富效应等替代解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 为期望偏差影响家庭财务决策提供了因果证据；展示了可得性启发式在现实金融决策中的具体作用机制；扩展了行为经济学在家庭金融领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构设计更好的贷款产品和风险管理系统提供参考；帮助政策制定者理解家庭财务决策中的行为偏差；为太阳能行业提供关于消费者还款行为的洞察。

title: Conditional Initialization for Enhanced Inference in Nonlinear State-Space Models
affiliations: University of Kiel

detail.title: Conditional Initialization for Enhanced Inference in Nonlinear State-Space Models
detail.abstract: This paper advances inference in nonlinear state-space models by deriving the distribution of initial endogenous states conditional on initial observations, addressing the general unknown nature of the unconditional distribution. Together with the inversion filter, this allows the likelihood to be evaluated deterministically and conditional on the initial observations. Such conditional likelihoods are commonly used in practice, e.g., when estimating autoregressive processes via least squares. Monte Carlo studies demonstrate that employing the conditional distribution of endogenous states can significantly enhance both Frequentist and Bayesian inference concerning states and parameters. The paper illustrates the method's practical relevance with two applications: first, a Monetary Business Cycle Accounting analysis of the COVID-19 recession and subsequent inflation surge in the US and Eurozone using a global solution; second, an evaluation of uncertainty shocks on the US business cycle during the Great Moderation via a third-order perturbation method. Additionally, the paper discusses limitations of the inversion filter and proposes remedies, particularly for spurious many-to-one policy function mappings that arise with higher-order perturbation solutions.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过推导初始内生状态在初始观测条件下的分布，改进了非线性状态空间模型的推断方法，解决了无条件分布通常未知的问题。结合反演滤波器，可以确定性地评估基于初始观测的条件似然。蒙特卡洛研究表明，使用内生状态的条件分布能显著提升频率学派和贝叶斯学派对状态和参数的推断效果。论文通过两个应用展示了方法的实际价值：使用全局解分析COVID-19衰退和通胀激增的货币商业周期核算；使用三阶扰动法评估大缓和时期不确定性冲击对美国商业周期的影响。
AI.research_question: 如何改进非线性状态空间模型的推断方法，特别是在无条件分布未知的情况下，通过推导初始内生状态在初始观测条件下的分布来提升参数和状态推断的准确性？
AI.motivation: 在非线性状态空间模型中，无条件分布通常未知，这给推断带来了挑战。实践中常用的条件似然方法（如自回归过程的OLS估计）需要更严格的理论基础。论文旨在为这类条件推断方法提供理论支持，并提升频率学派和贝叶斯推断的准确性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非线性状态空间模型理论、条件分布理论、反演滤波器理论、频率学派推断、贝叶斯推断、全局解方法、高阶扰动方法
AI.method: 1. 推导初始内生状态在初始观测条件下的分布理论；2. 结合反演滤波器实现确定性的条件似然评估；3. 蒙特卡洛模拟验证方法效果；4. 应用研究：使用全局解进行货币商业周期核算分析COVID-19衰退和通胀；使用三阶扰动法评估不确定性冲击对商业周期的影响
AI.findings: 1. 使用内生状态的条件分布能显著提升频率学派和贝叶斯推断的准确性；2. 反演滤波器在特定情况下存在局限性，特别是高阶扰动解中出现的虚假多对一映射问题；3. 论文提出了针对这些局限性的补救措施；4. 两个应用研究展示了方法在实际经济分析中的价值

title: Consumption Habit and Optimal Contract
affiliations: Boston University - Questrom School of Business and Boston University

detail.title: Consumption Habit and Optimal Contract
detail.abstract: This paper examines a continuous-time principal-agent model in which the agent's preference over consumption depends on the standard of living formed by a weighted average of past consumption. As the agent's concern over consumption habit strengthens, his continuation utility is less sensitive to current wealth, leading to a lower demand for contract risk compensation. The optimal contract has a lower pay-for-performance sensitivity but incentivizes a higher effort and improves welfare compared to the no-habit case. When the consumption habit concern approaches to its limit, the second-best optimal contract and effort converge to the first-best benchmark. In a capital structure model with agency friction à la He (2011), manager's habit formation preference partially mitigates the debt-overhang problem.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个连续时间委托代理模型，其中代理人的消费偏好取决于过去消费加权平均形成的生活标准。随着代理人消费习惯关注增强，其持续效用对当前财富的敏感性降低，导致对合同风险补偿的需求减少。最优合同具有较低的绩效薪酬敏感性，但激励更高的努力并提高福利。当消费习惯关注趋近极限时，次优合同和努力收敛于最优基准。在He（2011）的代理摩擦资本结构模型中，管理者的习惯形成偏好部分缓解了债务悬置问题。
AI.research_question: 消费习惯形成如何影响连续时间委托代理模型中的最优合同设计、激励效果和福利结果？
AI.motivation: 现有委托代理文献通常假设代理人偏好仅取决于当前消费，忽略了消费习惯形成对激励合同设计的影响。本文旨在探讨当代理人偏好依赖于过去消费形成的生活标准时，最优合同特征如何变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连续时间委托代理理论、消费习惯形成理论、资本结构理论（He, 2011的代理摩擦模型）
AI.method: 连续时间动态规划方法、最优控制理论、理论建模与分析
AI.findings: 1. 消费习惯关注增强使代理人持续效用对当前财富敏感性降低，减少合同风险补偿需求；2. 最优合同具有较低的绩效薪酬敏感性，但激励更高努力并提高福利；3. 当消费习惯关注趋近极限时，次优合同和努力收敛于最优基准；4. 在资本结构模型中，管理者习惯形成偏好部分缓解债务悬置问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将消费习惯形成纳入连续时间委托代理模型；2. 揭示了习惯形成如何改变最优合同的风险-激励权衡；3. 证明了在极端习惯关注下，次优合同可收敛于最优；4. 扩展了代理摩擦资本结构理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为考虑员工消费习惯的企业薪酬设计提供理论指导；2. 揭示了习惯形成在缓解代理问题中的积极作用；3. 为资本结构决策中考虑管理者偏好提供新视角。

title: Heterogeneous Effects of R&D Intensity on Idiosyncratic and Total Volatility: A Quantile Approach for Indian High-Tech Firms
affiliations: University of Kota and University of Kota

detail.title: Heterogeneous Effects of R&D Intensity on Idiosyncratic and Total Volatility: A Quantile Approach for Indian High-Tech Firms
detail.abstract: An analysis testing R&D intensity and stock return volatility relationship for high technology companies from 2013 to 2024 considers both idiosyncratic and total return volatilities. We apply two approaches to define R&D intensity: R&D to Sales (RD1) and R&D to Market Cap (RD2). This research employs a panel quantile regression method to address weaknesses associated with mean-oriented models.Empirical evidence indicates that while R&D intensity measured by market capitalization (RD2) has a positive and statistically significant impact on idiosyncratic volatility for higher quantiles, for total volatility, there is no significant relationship with R&D variables, indicating that systematic market factors are dominant in total risk behavior. R&D to Sales (RD1), although theoretically associated with innovation efforts, has a weaker explanation to offer because it is sensitive to short-term sales variability.These results suggest that innovation can serve as a signaling device for growth potential and create firm-specific uncertainties, especially for tech and long-gestation industries. This study contributes to the existing literature because it provides new evidence from the Indian evolving tech industry, which corresponds to the global outcomes from developed countries. In terms of implications, there should be greater emphasis on transparency in R&D disclosure and cap structure and investor literacy to mitigate market instability driven by innovation.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用面板分位数回归方法，分析了2013-2024年印度高科技公司研发强度与股票回报波动率的关系。研究发现，以市值衡量的研发强度（RD2）对高分位数的特质波动率有显著正向影响，但对总波动率无显著关系，表明系统性市场因素主导总风险。以销售额衡量的研发强度（RD1）解释力较弱，因其对短期销售波动敏感。
AI.research_question: 研发强度如何影响高科技公司的股票回报波动率？具体而言，研发强度对特质波动率和总波动率的影响有何不同？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注研发强度与平均回报的关系，但较少探讨其对波动率的影响，特别是在新兴市场如印度的高科技行业。传统均值导向模型存在局限性，需要更精细的分位数回归方法来捕捉不同风险水平下的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于创新信号理论（创新作为增长潜力的信号）和公司特定不确定性理论。研发活动既可能传递增长信号，也可能增加公司特有的不确定性，从而影响股票波动率。
AI.method: 采用面板分位数回归方法，分析2013-2024年印度高科技公司数据。使用两种研发强度衡量指标：RD1（研发支出/销售额）和RD2（研发支出/市值）。分别考察对特质波动率和总波动率的影响。
AI.findings:
1. 以市值衡量的研发强度（RD2）对高分位数的特质波动率有显著正向影响
2. 研发强度对总波动率无显著关系，表明系统性市场因素主导总风险
3. 以销售额衡量的研发强度（RD1）解释力较弱，因其对短期销售波动敏感
4. 创新可作为增长潜力信号，同时创造公司特定不确定性
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 为创新信号理论和公司特定不确定性理论提供了新的实证证据
2. 揭示了研发强度对波动率影响的非线性特征（在不同分位数上表现不同）
3. 证实了印度新兴科技市场与发达国家类似的市场机制
4. 拓展了分位数回归方法在金融研究中的应用
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 建议加强研发信息披露透明度
2. 优化资本结构管理
3. 提高投资者金融素养，以缓解创新驱动的市场不稳定性
4. 为高科技公司风险管理提供参考
5. 为监管机构制定相关政策提供依据

title: Trust and be Flexible! Strategic Plan Quality in Collaborative Networks
affiliations: University of Bologna, University of Bologna and University of Florence - Department of Business Economics

detail.title: Trust and be Flexible! Strategic Plan Quality in Collaborative Networks

contentType.other: Working Paper (a previous version of this paper was also presented at IRSPM 2025 conference: 7-9 April, 2025)

detail.abstract:
Critics have long questioned the efficacy of strategic planning in public management, arguing that
its rigidity may suit simple routine organizations but struggle to accommodate the complexity of
modern local government systems and their networks. Our study empirically investigates the factors
influencing strategic plan quality in collaborative network contexts. Specifically, with the adoption
of a novel, hand-collected dataset based on a pilot Italian strategic planning initiative, we assess the
impact of cognitive styles, processes, and trust on strategic plan quality. Our findings emphasize the
role of trust and flexibility as key drivers of collaborative strategic planning.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了在协作网络环境中影响战略规划质量的因素，特别关注认知风格、流程和信任的作用，发现信任和灵活性是协作战略规划的关键驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 在协作网络环境中，哪些因素影响战略规划的质量？特别是认知风格、流程和信任如何影响战略规划的质量？
AI.motivation: 长期以来，批评者质疑战略规划在公共管理中的有效性，认为其刚性可能适合简单的常规组织，但难以适应现代地方政府系统及其网络的复杂性。因此需要实证研究协作网络环境中的战略规划质量影响因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略规划理论、协作治理理论、网络治理理论、认知风格理论、信任理论
AI.method: 采用新颖的手工收集数据集，基于意大利战略规划试点项目，评估认知风格、流程和信任对战略规划质量的影响。
AI.findings: 研究发现信任和灵活性是协作战略规划的关键驱动因素，认知风格和流程也对战略规划质量产生影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为协作网络环境中的战略规划理论提供实证支持；2. 扩展了认知风格和信任在战略规划中的作用理论；3. 挑战了传统战略规划刚性假设，强调灵活性的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为地方政府在复杂网络环境中实施战略规划提供实践指导；2. 强调建立信任和保持灵活性的重要性；3. 为公共管理者改进战略规划质量提供具体建议。

detail.abstract:
This paper advances The Constitutional Doctrine of Monetary Closure: Elasticity, Institutional Memory, and National Continuity as a formal constitutional doctrine rather than a work of descriptive fiscal history. It articulates a unifying legal principle: a constitutional monetary system must preserve the capacity to terminate obligations lawfully under stress while remaining continuously accountable to democratic authority. Where closure fails, legitimacy erodes; where accountability fails, sovereignty thins.

The Doctrine identifies three interlocking constitutional requirements. Elasticity is necessary to prevent scarcity from converting economic contraction into coercive enforcement. Institutional memory is required to ensure that extraordinary measures remain intelligible, reviewable, and corrigible across generations rather than hardening into unexamined precedent. National continuity depends on the lawful integration of both—so that obligations incurred in crisis can be created deliberately, managed transparently, and resolved conclusively without fracturing consent.

The paper introduces Architectural Sovereignty Contagion (ASC) as a long-horizon constitutional risk: the gradual migration of sovereign-adjacent monetary and settlement authority into systems operating beyond electoral consent, legislative oversight, or institutional correction. ASC is framed not as illegality, but as structural dilution—authority exercised in practice without accountability in law. Drawing on Founding-era failures under the Articles of Confederation, subsequent constitutional design, and modern crisis responses, the Doctrine demonstrates that rigidity without accommodation and accommodation without accountability constitute symmetric constitutional failures.

This Doctrine is a companion paper to The Doctrine of Anchored Decentralization: A Law for the Stateless Economy. Together, the two works establish a coherent constitutional framework for modern governance: decentralized systems may operate only where authority remains anchored, visible, and corrigible within public institutions. Anchored Decentralization supplies the rule-of-law architecture for distributed systems; Monetary Closure supplies the constitutional condition that allows those systems to endure crisis without surrendering democratic legitimacy.

The central claim is precise and normative. National security is derivative of constitutional security. A republic survives not by eliminating stress, scarcity, or discretion, but by governing them through accountable institutions capable of lawful adaptation. Monetary authority that cannot accommodate crisis fractures society; monetary authority that cannot answer to the public dissolves sovereignty. The Constitution resolves this tension through accountable elasticity—an architecture of restraint, memory, and closure that enables the Republic to endure across crises without losing itself.

title: Will Systematic Risk Burst the AI Bubble? Technological Revolutions and Stock Prices Revisited
affiliations: University of Oregon and University of Oregon - Department of Finance

detail.title: Will Systematic Risk Burst the AI Bubble? Technological Revolutions and Stock Prices Revisited
detail.abstract: Pástor and Veronesi (2009) provide a rational explanation for stock price bubbles observed during technological revolutions. We argue that the proposed mechanism, based on sharply rising systematic risk as the new technology nears wider adoption, is unlikely to explain bubbles. We show that this mechanism is only present in an illustrative model with the simplifying assumption that a one-time all-or-nothing adoption decision for the new technology occurs at an exogenously fixed date. In contrast, there is no stock price bubble in the baseline calibration of the more realistic model that allows for optimal adoption of the technology at any time. More generally, we argue that the bubble pattern is not a natural feature of the more realistic model. We also argue that the behavior of earnings and stock prices in the DotCom bubble, as well as the current AI stock boom, provide no evidence of the necessary mechanism. Our results suggest that the bursting of an AI bubble is unlikely to arise from increased systematic risk accompanying further positive news about AI technology.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战了Pástor和Veronesi(2009)关于技术革命期间股票价格泡沫的理性解释，认为其机制（系统性风险随新技术接近广泛采用而急剧上升）不太可能解释泡沫现象。作者证明该机制仅在简化模型中存在，而在更现实的模型中不存在泡沫。研究还表明，互联网泡沫和当前AI股票热潮都不支持该机制。
AI.research_question: Pástor和Veronesi(2009)提出的基于系统性风险上升的机制是否真的能解释技术革命期间的股票价格泡沫？
AI.motivation: Pástor和Veronesi(2009)为技术革命期间的股票价格泡沫提供了理性解释，但该解释的机制是否真实有效需要验证。当前AI股票热潮使得理解技术泡沫的形成机制尤为重要。

title: Can STEM Designation Increase Diversity in Economics?
affiliations: University of Louisville and Manhattan University

detail.title: Can STEM Designation Increase Diversity in Economics?
detail.abstract: This study examines how STEM designation in economics impacts minority enrollment. While previous research emphasize international student recruitment, we explore whether the STEM classification influences the decisions of domestic minority students. Specifically, we assess whether the increased international student presence fosters a more inclusive environment, potentially attracting underrepresented groups. Using institutional-level enrollment data from the National Center of Education Statistics and changes in the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) STEM Designated Degree Program List, we apply a difference-indifferences design to provide empirical insights into the broader effects of STEM designation on student demographics. We find that STEM designation is associated with increased diversity among economics graduates, with gains driven primarily by growth in non-resident and female students rather than racial diversity among domestic students. Secondly, a survival analysis shows that institutions with larger enrollments, more international students, and who do not have a business school are less likely to remove the economics major and more likely to adopt the economics STEM degree. Lastly, we examine the subset of Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs) and find a substantial decline in the percentage of economics bachelor's degrees awarded to Black and African Americans by HBCUs relative to other universities.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨经济学STEM认证对少数族裔入学率的影响，发现STEM认证增加了经济学毕业生的多样性，但主要由国际学生和女性学生驱动，而非国内学生的种族多样性。研究还发现规模较大、国际学生较多、没有商学院的院校更可能保留经济学专业并采用STEM认证。HBCUs授予非裔美国人的经济学学士学位比例显著下降。
AI.research_question: 经济学STEM认证如何影响少数族裔学生的入学决策？特别是对国内少数族裔学生的影响如何？
AI.motivation: 以往研究主要关注STEM认证对国际学生招生的影响，但缺乏对国内少数族裔学生决策的研究。需要了解STEM认证是否通过增加国际学生存在而创造更包容的环境，从而吸引代表性不足的群体。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于STEM认证对高等教育多样性的影响理论，探讨国际学生存在与包容性环境的关系，以及院校特征对专业设置决策的影响。
AI.method: 使用国家教育统计中心的机构层面入学数据和美国国土安全部STEM指定学位项目列表的变化，采用双重差分法分析STEM认证对学生人口统计特征的影响，并对HBCUs进行子集分析。
AI.findings: 1. STEM认证与经济学毕业生多样性增加相关，但主要由非居民（国际）学生和女性学生驱动，而非国内学生的种族多样性。2. 规模较大、国际学生较多、没有商学院的院校更可能保留经济学专业并采用STEM学位。3. HBCUs授予非裔美国人的经济学学士学位比例相对于其他大学显著下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了STEM认证影响的理论框架，从单纯关注国际学生扩展到国内少数族裔学生，揭示了STEM认证对多样性的复杂影响机制，特别是国际学生存在与包容性环境的关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高等教育机构提供政策建议：1. STEM认证可能增加国际学生和女性学生，但对国内少数族裔学生影响有限。2. 院校特征影响专业设置决策。3. HBCUs需要特别关注维持非裔美国学生在经济学领域的代表性。

title: Sheep and Goat Pox in Greece (2024–2025) A Political Economy, Public Policy, and Moral-Philosophical Analysis of a Category A Epizootic
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Sheep and Goat Pox in Greece (2024–2025) A Political Economy, Public Policy, and Moral-Philosophical Analysis of a Category A Epizootic
detail.abstract: The 2024–2025 resurgence of sheep and goat pox (SGP) in Greece has behaved less like a self-contained veterinary incident and more like a stress-test of collective action, state capacity, and political legitimacy in a livestock-dependent economy. SGP is a listed Category A disease under the EU Animal Health Law, triggering eradication logic, movement controls, surveillance, and—de facto—rapid depopulation and disinfection. Yet the Greek episode shows how legally coherent measures can underperform when implementation meets fragmented supply chains, heterogeneous incentives, uneven enforcement, and contested risk communication.Using an interdisciplinary design spanning veterinary epidemiology, agricultural economics, political theory, and public policy, the paper frames SGP control as a public-goods problem marked by strategic behaviour, information asymmetries, and moral hazard. It applies a mechanism-design lens to reporting, movement compliance, and biosecurity investment, linking micro-incentives to persistence, regional spillovers, and social conflict. An empirical section draws on Greece’s laboratory announcements and surveillance records (12 September 2024–12 December 2025) to map spatial concentration, temporal waves, and operational burden. Policy instruments (zoning, movement restrictions, stamping-out, compensation, and intensified surveillance) are assessed against effectiveness, proportionality, feasibility, equity, and liberal legitimacy.The paper argues that improvement requires treating SGP governance as a coordination problem at the intersection of law, incentives, and trust. It proposes an integrated package centred on incentive-compatible compensation, traceability data infrastructure, co-regulation with producer organisations, and risk communication designed to reduce blame dynamics and “social automatism”.

detail.title: The Feldstein-Horioka Puzzle in CEE Countries

publicationDetails.detailsText: No, it does not. This paper is currently a work in progress and has not yet been submitted for journal publication.

detail.abstract:
This paper examines the relationship between domestic savings and gross investment in 14
Central and Eastern European (CEE) countries from 2000 to 2024 using annual panel data.
Building on Feldstein and Horioka (1980), who highlighted a high savings–investment
correlation in developed economies (the FH puzzle), I investigate whether this pattern holds in
transition economies. To address cross-sectional dependence, slope heterogeneity,
endogeneity, and structural breaks, we employ the Common Correlated Effects Mean Group
(CCEMG) estimator. The results indicate a high, but significantly below one, savings retention
coefficient (0.43), suggesting that the FH puzzle does not hold in CEE countries. Sub-period
analysis shows an increase from 0.32 before the 2008 financial crisis to 0.42 afterward,
reflecting the growing importance of domestic savings in financing investment as these
economies develop and foreign capital inflows moderate. My findings emphasize the critical
role of domestic savings in supporting investment and offer insights into the dynamics of
financial integration and macroeconomic resilience in transition economies

AI.research_question: 中东欧转型经济体中是否存在Feldstein-Horioka之谜（即储蓄与投资之间的高度相关性）？国内储蓄与总投资之间的关系在这些经济体中如何随时间变化？
AI.motivation: Feldstein和Horioka（1980）在发达经济体中发现了储蓄-投资高度相关的"FH之谜"，但这一模式在转型经济体中的有效性尚不清楚。中东欧国家经历了经济转型和金融一体化过程，研究其储蓄-投资关系有助于理解这些经济体的金融整合程度和宏观经济韧性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Feldstein-Horioka（1980）的储蓄-投资相关性理论框架，该理论认为在资本流动性高的经济体中，国内储蓄与投资应呈现低相关性，但实证研究发现发达经济体存在高相关性（FH之谜）。研究探讨这一理论在转型经济体中的适用性。
AI.method: 使用2000-2024年14个中东欧国家的年度面板数据，采用Common Correlated Effects Mean Group（CCEMG）估计方法，该方法能够处理横截面依赖性、斜率异质性、内生性和结构断裂问题。进行子时期分析比较金融危机前后的变化。
AI.findings:
1. 储蓄保留系数为0.43，显著低于1，表明FH之谜在中东欧国家不成立
2. 子时期分析显示：2008年金融危机前系数为0.32，危机后上升至0.42
3. 随着经济发展和外国资本流入减缓，国内储蓄在投资融资中的重要性增加
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将FH理论扩展到转型经济体，发现与发达经济体不同的模式
2. 提供了转型经济体金融整合程度的实证证据
3. 揭示了储蓄-投资关系随经济发展阶段变化的动态特征
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者强调国内储蓄对支持投资的重要性
2. 为理解转型经济体的宏观经济韧性提供见解
